title: Dumb Couple Is Convinced Laws Don’t Apply To Them
description:
On July 19th, 2022, officers responded to a case of domestic battery. The caller advised that a man and a woman had been fighting throughout the day and were also involved in a physical altercation. The woman was bleeding from her nose, and the hotel room they were staying in had blood stains all over. She was upset and believed that her friend didn’t belong with them. Shortly after, the medics arrived. The male grew agitated and began screaming.  Both of them were transported to jail. Alexis was also put under arrest since she was refusing to leave the hotel room even after the officer’s repeated request. The male continued to scream and yell at his wife’s friend. The male & the female were charged with domestic battery while their friend was charged with trespass.

#news
--------------

0:00 Highlights
0:11 He hit his wife
3:08 I don’t want her here
6:24 She’s a bitch
9:17 Couple arrested
13:15 I want your sergeant
16:47 Friend arrested
20:35 She’s a whore!
22:25 Charges

About Us / Disclaimer: 

Police Insider provides unbiased and authentic footage of incidents captured on body cams. We believe this footage can be used as an educational guide for viewers. 

We only provide unique and original content that hasn’t been covered before on YouTube.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
